title: Fix runtime-expanded JSFL test failures: renameItem null-safety + setSelectionRect off-by-one
description:
packages/authoring-ui/src/jsfl/__tests__/runtime-expanded.test.ts has 2 confirmed failures:
1. renameItem: 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading items)' — library.items is undefined during rename; need null-safety guard in the renameItem implementation
2. setSelectionRect: expected ['1'] got ['2'] — selection count off-by-one when rect selects objects

Run: pnpm --filter @flash/authoring-ui run test -- --run to verify. Both failures must go to 0.
